reuse.why: The tree has no existing uniqueness check; the change adds one helper and calls it from every provider link function, using the existing db.first access pattern.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once; each of the five copied link functions repeats only a three-argument call with its own provider literal, mirroring the tree's existing per-provider copies.

placement.why: The guard sits next to the link functions in accounts/app.ts at the start of each, before any bank, account or sync side effect; link.ts would have been an equally natural home.

scope.why: Only the guard and its five calls; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: A single clearly named guard owns the rule; the provider string is repeated at the call site and again in each function's insert/update, which a maintainer must keep in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five link paths call assertBankAccountNotLinked.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is duplicated; one helper is shared by all link functions.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called first by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount.
